This scratch workflow compares two retained public compilers on the complete frozen original shipping corpus. It executes no compiler build and no candidate source overlay. The equally repaired feature-free baseline is bbf90260694e2e3004030c35b57f012a98b7c65d; the feature product is 4e50e86cde6ab2ef6cab0762ffc4df59d646dc15. Both omit the extended-newtype-bases option. The retained artifact may contain another diagnostic compiler, but this package's two-arm guard excludes it from extraction and execution.

The immutable workload definition is copied from 09cab7775e83988ef5a38d86b971d8b203fcad63. matrix.py, plan.py, run.py, repair82.py, prepare.py, all canonical commands, 4,770 old input hashes, 59 separate #82 input/oracle files, and every original expected table remain byte-identical. The original canonical planner's Unicode filtering and option precedence remain intact. There is no additional global refresh or Unicode axis, no new budget, seed, ordering option or golden update.

The matrix has 38 paired jobs: eight canonical suite shards (four shards for each AdditionalAxioms wrapper axis), 28 complete Std parts (seven parts for each of two solvers and two wrapper axes), and two whole-source literal #82 shards. The original suite contains 1,081 programs per axis, split 271/270/270/270. It requests 2,162 canonical pairs, 28 Std pairs, and 93 #82 compiler-call pairs: 2,283 pairs or 4,566 physical compiler invocations. The #82 scope has five source rows, 150 literal mappings per arm, 54 OutputCheck commands and three diff commands. Its original flags and solver macros are separate from the old suite denominator. Some verify commands deliberately stop during resolution; actual proof declaration/batch counts are measured outputs.

The archives are the baseline and final members of public run 37347177735, artifact 11361575690. That run reused their exact successful archives from public run 37325330127. Baseline tar SHA256 is d306f2413073b3ad8569d555a2141543becb43cba8bc4762289a59081e0f3771; final is 12a1fcc022faf697f28637f132c2e7222207b0b0a2389995495cc3554b934ff8. Each has 329 files, 208 managed/apphost components, and seven bundled libraries. The seven library hashes match; compiler components are compared to each arm's own receipt, not required to match across products.

The original final build's source.txt names scratch commit 31f49205d82e73a8db944ef0b9c2be063736d72c. Its complete Source tree is 9c2bb48a778ee2abd6ef10f8a0d72f7843a16af5, byte-identical to product4e50 and the frozen recording commit09cab. Core is 1be0fe66bc603a9fc279e522e925be22417a7c41 and Driver208a4277a53e6dc068f5ed2f36e5824a6097bece. The workflow guards the recording checkout against these trees, so an accidental candidate source adoption cannot enter this measurement. Baseline composition is the existing audited Core-only patch from public4b, with recorded full tree0b8aa84095a7754ab6443cb2a03e6326074e4bed, Source6a46c2b5fa64ba2cc69b803e8a6ae7698964da9e and Corefac1a44e6c74e2cba489692ab3477396d25b6317. CI does not fetch a private baseline commit.

Fresh API metadata is obtained after artifact download and checked for repository, run, recording head, artifact ID/name/digest/size and expiry. Original build/source/version/identity guards, physical tar files and modes, actual extracted components and libraries are checked before execution. Both named solver archives are hash-pinned; actual executable version and hash are recorded. Source inputs, observer files, all extracted compiler files/modes, libraries, retained archives and solver bytes are checked again after each job.

Pairs remain on the same runner and input cwd, in the existing balanced arm order. Same-invocation JSON, CSV and BPL are retained. Std uses the original complete project selections and default declaration order. Canonical program options remain last, including explicit overrides and intended malformed flags. Each resource comparison stays within its actual solver; mixed-solver totals are not a price comparison.

All expected diagnostic failures are recorded with exit0 at the workflow boundary. Missing phases, crashes, time/resource caps, warning lines, original negative outputs and valid-contract failures remain raw outcomes. The original aggregate report is retained unchanged; the additional closure report distinguishes complete physical observations from successful original checks. It never claims proof-green, source acceptance, solver-query identity or cost parity. In particular, byte-equal translated BPL does not establish equality of engine scheduling or solver sessions. Unchanged development results are historical reuse, not new measurements.

This source-only preparation executes no compiler, backend, verifier or solver. Public observations and an independent review are still required. Artifact expiry, runner capacity, missing mandatory observations, the existing common callback failures, and actual declaration/batch resource movement remain unresolved execution/review boundaries rather than waivers.
